items.title: CEO Switch At Omnicom Advertising As Robertson Succeeds Ruhanen

items.title: SIRI Showered Owners With Cash. The Stock Still Lagged The Market
items.summary: The satellite radio giant sent owners a fortune in cash, yet the stock went backward over those five years (it has actually outpaced the market over the past year). Here is the accounting of what that trade actually delivered, and what has to go right from here.

items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 That Underwhelm

items.title: Omnicom (OMC) Stock Looks Pricey Even With Strong Cash Flow
items.summary: Omnicom Group stock has delivered a 47.3% total return over the past 5 years, yet its valuation checks send mixed signals, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate pointing to upside while market multiples lean the other way. A 47.3% return over 5 years suggests Omnicom Group has rewarded patient shareholders, which raises the bar for any new valuation case. For a marketing services group, the key support for the valuation can come from steady cash generation and disciplined capital...
